implementation.flow: Asset card -> Riverpod family controller -> repository -> fixed-origin service -> validated immutable quote
implementation.scope: Exact USDF/ASBNB asset symbols in displayed Spot/Futures cards; public rate shared across markets, never a personal earned rate
implementation.precision: Bounded exact JSON parser keeps original numeric tokens; Decimal for rates and sum/multiplication; two decimal display only
implementation.missing: No fallback to zero, apr, latest list sorting or guessed asset aliases. Missing/invalid dates/rates, mismatched USDF component dates or unsuccessful envelope rejected; previous quote retained on refresh failure
implementation.freshness: Received <5 minutes ago; source calendar date not ahead of UTC today and at most two calendar days old; future receive/publisher timestamps beyond30sec mark stale. UTC dates are publisher calendar labels, not inferred precise timestamps
implementation.refresh: First displayed subscription, explicit retry and five-minute refresh only while foreground; per-asset dedup; families share one repository and close clients after disposal; no source loaded for unsupported assets
implementation.lifecycle: Background cancels timers, marks quote stale and discards late reads; foreground explicitly schedules public re-read; last listener disposal cancels timers and discards late data
implementation.ux: Compact expandable rate, source date/received time, optional publisher time, USDF components, source and conditional/estimated yield explanation; localized loading/partial failure/stale/paused/retry; financial quantities unchanged
implementation.authentication: No wallet, signature, address, balance, Privy token, extra wallet or financial write needed

boundaries: These are anonymous website/third-party endpoints with observed source evidence, not a documented long-term Aster developer contract
A fresh HTTP response may carry old source data; it remains labeled historical
No Swap, staking action, deposit/withdrawal, individual income, asset name/logo metadata or full Portfolio added
Real phone networks, native expansion/scrolling/large text/lifecycle and iOS remain unverified at user request
